channel.title: Violations Watch: South Sudan
channel.description: New incidents reported in South Sudan. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: MSF suspends all activities in Yei River County, South Sudan, after two of its health workers were abducted
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Yei, Central Equatoria, South Sudan. Types: Abduction & hostage-taking, Attacks on healthcare & aid. Alleged perpetrator: Unidentified armed men. Grave violations against children: Attacks on schools and hospitals. 4 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1890

item.title: Attack on a cattle camp in Tonj East, Warrap State, kills 15 to 24 civilians, including women and children; local officials blame SPLA-IO-affiliated fighters and armed men from Unity State
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Tonj East, Warrap State, South Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: SPLA-IO-affiliated fighters and armed youth from Unity State (alleged by local officials). Reported casualties: 15-24 killed. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: Tolls differ (15, 21, 24); attribution by local officials; Sudans Post reports 87 dead and 60 injured in Tonj East (may include fighters). 8 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1782

item.title: Attack in Duk County, Jonglei State, on 21 Nov kills seven and injures 10; 2,351 cattle raided (Radio Tamazuj)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Duk County, Jonglei State, South Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Armed raiders (unidentified). Reported casualties: 7 killed, 10 injured. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1798

item.title: Two young men arrested by SSPDF soldiers in Kapoeta in October were killed, Eastern Equatoria's caretaker governor confirms; suspects held by the military in Juba
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Kapoeta, Eastern Equatoria, South Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians, Arbitrary detention & disappearance. Alleged perpetrator: South Sudan People's Defence Forces soldiers. Reported casualties: 2 killed. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1420

item.title: Three aid workers abducted at gunpoint on the Yei-Maridi road, Central Equatoria, South Sudan, on 9 Nov freed after a $2,500 ransom (Radio Tamazuj)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Yei, Central Equatoria, South Sudan. Types: Abduction & hostage-taking, Attacks on healthcare & aid. Alleged perpetrator: Unidentified gunmen. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1037

item.title: South Sudan: UN-supported screening identifies 54 children among police recruits; child protection team checks police training centres in Western Equatoria and other states (UNMISS, Radio Tamazuj)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Northern Bahr El Ghazal, Warrap and Western Bahr El Ghazal, South Sudan. Types: Abduction & hostage-taking. Alleged perpetrator: South Sudan National Police Service. Grave violations against children: Recruitment and use. Disputed or caveats: Some children reportedly spent three to four months in training; recruitment dates not stated. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1038

item.title: Gunmen kill two SPLM delegates and leave several missing in an attack between Mundri East and Mundri West, South Sudan
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Mundri, Western Equatoria, South Sudan. Types: Killing of civilians, Abduction & hostage-taking. Alleged perpetrator: Unidentified gunmen. Reported casualties: 2 killed. Disputed or caveats: Single outlet (Sudans Post); fate of missing unclear. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0659
